criteria: Measured transformed PNG ink centerlines from actual drawImage commands, and verified vector squeeze paths against their actual canvas path commands. Reported glyph rotation alone is not used as proof.
Source closed arcs on faces 16, 21, 22, 23, 26, 29 and 35 retain their curvature sign and endpoint attitude within 12 degrees.
Angry faces 02 and 04 retain mirrored lid tilt: left positive, right negative, with a broad 5 to 25 degree range.
Round faces 09 and 20 close within 5 degrees of screen level.
Ranges are visual acceptance choices, not claims about anatomical correctness.
limitations: The tests assess fully closed poses. Root browser review must also judge the visible closing and reopening motion.
Centerline measurement approximates a stylized thick stroke; it does not measure GPU antialiasing.
Preserving source arc concavity is distinct from forcing all eyes to the same closure curve.
